reviews.title: Good picture and high resolution at a good price
reviews.comment: Paired with a DVI to USB-C cable this monitor works great for a home office. The display is crisp and the colors are great. I'm using it for an extension for may Mac Book and the monitor is just about as good as the rentina display in the Mac Book. Not a gamer do I can't speak to refresh rates and such but for watching YouTube videos and office work, this monitor is the best bang for your buck you can get I think.
reviews.author: Florida man

reviews.title: Works with my Mac Studio
reviews.comment: I wanted a dual display setup for my Mac Studio. I was able to get two beautiful 4k displays for less than I could get 1 of some other brands. Some people feel that if you are going to pay so much for a computer you need to go ahead and also pay top dollar for monitors. I don't disagree with that mindset, but I also think it's important to stay within your budget, lol. These screens checked all the boxes for me. They connect directly from the Mac using thunderbolt to display port cables. The screens look great. The colors a nice and vibrant and the image is sharp. I have edited photos and video with them and paired with the Mac Studio they are a major upgrade from my old set up. I went back and watched some videos I edited some time ago and I feel like I was seeing my videos for the first time. The only compromise has been that I can't control the screen brightness from the computer or keyboard. This brings up the one negative I have had from the monitors is that the menu system is not the best. IF you don't care about having an OLED display but want a great 4k monitor, I definitely recommend these.
reviews.author: Faith

reviews.title: I highly recommend upgrading to 4k
reviews.comment: I thought I was buying a 4k monitor to help me with my video editing... previously I was editing 4k videos on a non-4k monitor.  I have to say, the difference in video upgrading to this monitor was pretty underwhelming.  BUT, I was never expecting text and regular tasks on the PC to look so crisp.  It was like going from 20/40 vision to 20/15. This listing is for several products, the one I'm reviewing is PRO MP273U. When I first unboxed this monitor and started using it, it immediately blasted me with eye pain and strain. I had to go into the settings on the monitor using the 5 buttons on the bottom (which is NOT an intuitive process) and turn the brightness WAY down.  Rest assured, unless you're trying to use this monitor outside on the beach in direct sunlight, it can be plenty bright in any environment.  I read that insufficient brightness was a problem in other budget 4k monitors, that is definitely not the case with this model. In Windows 11, if HDR is activated with this monitor, it cranks the brightness way up and there is no way to turn that down.  This is fine if watching HDR videos, but afterwards I need to go back into Windows settings and turn the HDR off.  So there are extra steps required if one wants to watch videos in HDR and then later check email or whatever without getting blasted with too much brightness. I don't have any regrets.  I would have preferred a larger monitor, or one with 120 Hz, or easier HDR management, but I didn't buy those things.  I bought what I could afford. I almost forgot to include, this monitor has speakers.  The sound quality is horrible, so should only be considered as an emergency backup option.  I didn't factor this into my rating.  I just provide this as information. I bought this on a Black Friday "deal" that looked dramatic and as I write this review two months later.... it's being sold for the exact same price!  So don't get suckered when you shop around.
reviews.author: My Eyes Are Up Here!

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: 4k on a 27" display is a bit too much for me when it comes to user interface, but looks great nonetheless, and you can just use GUI upscaling or lower the resolution to make things look bigger. This monitor has great value as it doesn't have useless features like 144Hz and such, it has HDR though, but I don't use it. I come from using a 15.6" laptop and didn't expect this monitor to be this HUGE, looks almost as twice as big, which is a great thing for me.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
